subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
Common Data For 8 and 9 : 
Ten telemetry signals, each of bandwidth 2 kHz, are to be 
transmitted simultaneously by binary PCM. The maximum 
tolerable error in sample amplitudes is 0.2% of the peak 
signal amplitude. The signals must be sampled at least 20% 
above the Nyquist rate. Framing and synchronizing 
requires an additional 1% extra bits. 
8.
The minimum possible data rate must be
(a)
272.64 k bits/sec
(b)
436.32 k bits/sec
(c)
936.32 k bits/sec
(d)
None of the above
9.
The minimum transmission bandwidth is
(a)
218.16 kHz
(b)
468.32 kHz
(c)
136.32 kHz
(d)
None of the above
Common Data For 10 to 12 : 
Consider a linear DM system designed to accommodate 
analog message signals limited to the bandwidth of 3.5 
kHz. A sinusoidal test signal of amplitude Am = 1 V and 
frequency fm = 800 Hz is applied to the system. The 
sampling rate of the system is 64 kHz.
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-05 (ECE/IN).
